title: Paste Text Margins (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Paste Text Margins applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Paste Text Margins (BtnSetMargin) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Margin paste plan is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The paste plan resolves the context menu's combinations: a non-reset paste requires learned session data and writes the learned values for the selected axes only; reset is always allowed, resolves zeros and honors the axis selection (a horizontal reset never writes the vertical pair); an unselected axis is protected by its write flag, not by preserving values in the plan.

scenarios.title: Paste Text Margins applies the staged margins to the real TextFrame in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Paste Text Margins with a staged MarginState (Left=7 Right=9 Top=11 Bottom=13) on one selected text box sets all four TextFrame margins to exactly those values (measured left=7 right=9 top=11 bottom=13 with leftChanged=True), returns true, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
